requirement_vague: Updating a todo with mismatched ID returns bad request

omissions.description: PUT /todos/{id} does not reject requests where the body id differs from the path id with 400 Bad Request.
omissions.reasoning: The update_todo route accepts TodoUpdate with an optional id field, but it never compares todo_in.id to the path parameter id. It proceeds to update the todo whenever the todo exists, so a mismatched body id is not handled and no 400 response is returned.
